unsupported: The company was founded in 1968 by Bill and Connie Lander in the basement of their New York home and remains a closely held, family‑owned corporation.
Leadership passed to their son Bruce Lander in 1997, and the board today includes Bruce as chairman and family shareholders Connie Lander and Debora Lussier.

Four New Hampshire facilities in Milton, Dover, Merrimack, and Somersworth provide roughly 290,000 square feet of combined design, engineering, production, and warehousing space, supported by a workforce of more than 200 employees.

Index Packaging emphasizes its “Protection by Design” philosophy, citing in‑house design and engineering at no cost to qualified buyers, the convenience of foam, wood, and corrugated capabilities under one roof, and the agility of a family‑owned structure that enables quick decision‑making.
